notes.title: Exciting Upcoming Adult Visual Novel!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812783/85f65573cba4bc28cfd9a4b4cfa51d90d88eb8d0.jpg[/img]

I’m thrilled to share some exciting news! 
Introducing you to our upcoming adult visual novel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022950/In_Your_Shoes_An_NSFW_MILF__Daughter_Sex_VN/?utm_source=steam_crosspromo&utm_medium=crosspromo_article&utm_campaign=bwh]In Your Shoes[/url], created by the very talented Mac Hanson!

[h3]A New Story, New Characters, and New Experiences[/h3]
    • Immerse yourself in a rich, emotional narrative with complex characters, including the captivating Norah, the kind-hearted MILF with a mysterious past (get to know her in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3022950/view/497181280806372039]this post[/url])
    • Explore the game's unique themes, tackling love, loss, and longing in a thought-provoking way
    • Enjoy an engaging visual novel experience with beautifully rendered characters and deep relationships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812783/b9e9ec0df66bed751cf61d2b964148968f419326.jpg[/img]
